title: A click selects an object in acre-gui until another click
body:
A click on the render sends `goto` for the node under the pointer (`App::go_to_object_at`), and the outline that `App::marks` draws follows the neovim cursor. Nothing stays selected.

## Proposal

- A click on an object selects it. Its objects stay outlined in a colour of their own until a click on empty canvas or on another object. With the link, the click still sends `goto`.
- A drag that starts on an object moves it, selected or not. A drag on empty canvas pans.
- The selection survives the rebuild after an edit. It is kept as the node's path in the source tree (the indices of the node and its ancestors among their siblings), because an edit shifts spans.
- No new key bindings.
